Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

get rid of verb

also rid, be rid of, get rid of someone, throw out, dispose of, do away with, eliminate, get rid of worries, banish worries

classical

Ter. Ad. 4.2.14: ego hunc āmovēbō (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Att. 1.12: illum ex istīs locīs āmovē (Lewis & Short)

āmoveō, āmovēre, āmōvī, āmōtum

verb, second conjugation, transitive

get rid of, remove, send away

Of people and things, and of feelings: āmōtō metū, fear set aside (Ter. And. 1.2.10).

Other words

  • āmōlior, āmōlīrī, āmōlītus sum — get rid of (with effort), shift

    verb, fourth conjugation, deponent · also used · classical · Traupman 99, 321, 377: istum molestum āmōlīrī volō, I want to get rid of that pest; Plaut. Ps. 3.2.67: āmōlīrī omnia (Lewis & Short); Traupman 99, 157

    (chiefly comic (Plaut., Ter.) and post-Augustan prose (Plin., Tac.); never in Cicero (Lewis & Short))

    To shift something heavy, and so to get a nuisance off one’s hands; hinc vōs āmōlīminī, clear off! (Ter. And. 4.2.24).

  • tollō, tollere, sustulī, sublātum — do away with, get rid of

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical

    Of a thing done away with altogether (a law, a custom, a fear); first of all to lift (see lift, raise).

  • līberor, līberārī, līberātus sum — be rid of, be freed from

    the passive of līberō, with ablative · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 6.1.10: aliquem magnā sollicitūdine līberāre (Lewis & Short)

    For “be rid of” a worry, a debt, a duty: eā cūrā līberātus sum.

  • dīluō, dīluere, dīluī, dīlūtum — to wash away, dispel (worries)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 157

    Literally “wash away”: so of cares washed away with wine.

  • eximō, eximere, exēmī, exēmptum — to take away, banish (worries)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 149

Examples

  • age, tamen ego hunc āmovēbō

    all right, I’ll get rid of him all the sameTer. Ad. 4.2.14 (Lewis & Short)

  • illum ex istīs locīs āmovē

    get him away from thereCic. Att. 1.12 (Lewis & Short)

  • hinc vōs āmōlīminī

    clear off, both of youTer. And. 4.2.24 (Lewis & Short)

See also remove, delete, free, lift.
